description: For years, families and businesses in Connecticut have struggled with some of the highest electricity costs in the nation. And now this week, Eversource filed another major rate increase. The company's own estimate would raise residential bills by roughly 11% and potentially up to 18% if storm-related costs are added on top. I oppose the electricity rate increase.
title: Standing up to Eversource’s rate hike - Jill Oberlander for State Senate
